name: bonzo-lend
description: Bonzo Finance lending on Hedera — supply, borrow, repay, withdraw with HTS association checks, optional HCS audit trail, and AuditAnchor.

steps.label: Generate or import a deployer account
Fund the account from the Hedera Portal faucet, then get Bonzo testnet HTS assets (Discord #testnet-faucet or SaucerSwap testnet)
Optional: create an HCS audit topic (set HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID/KEY), then save HCS_AUDIT_TOPIC_ID

steps.text: Open /markets, associate HTS tokens in HashPack if needed, then supply via /supply.
